pages.text: Cold Sweat gives you a body temperature. Hot or cold places push it up or down, and if it goes too far you take damage and cannot sleep.$(br2)It is a layer of survival, not a puzzle: dress for the biome and keep a heat source nearby.

pages.title: Thermometer
pages.text: Shows the temperature of the place you stand in. Your body temperature has its own icon on the HUD.

$(thing)World temperature$() is what the spot feels like: biome, time of day, height or depth, nearby fire, lava or ice, water.$(br2)$(thing)Body temperature$() drifts toward it. Armor insulation and warm or cold blocks slow that drift.
pages.title: Two numbers

pages.text: Getting wet cools you, and a netherite diving suit makes you immune to that. Heat and cold can both be lethal.$(br2)You cannot sleep while overheating or freezing.$(br2)After you spawn or die you get Grace, a short immunity to temperature damage.
pages.title: Water and danger

pages.text: Higher is colder. The pack adds $(l:survival/temperature_create)Cold Sweat: Altitude$(/l), which sets temperature bands by height, adds wind and lets sewn linings shield you.$(br2)Mountains, sky islands and airships are where it bites.
pages.title: Altitude

pages.text: Cold Sweat covers the Overworld and Aether. Northstar's planets have their own temperature system, set by each world and a Temperature Regulator block. It is separate from Cold Sweat: no link exists between them.
